title: Looks and feels impressive but is not great for cooking with liquid ingredients such as eggs or pancakes
text:
Looks and feels impressive but is not great for cooking with liquid ingredients such as eggs or pancakes. The Amazon title says this pan is small but that is not true. It is very large (11.25 inches) as you can see from the picture and extends beyond my large burner. I need a lot of room on the sides to prevent the handle from hanging over the stove.

I love the teal color and how wonderful the pan feels. It also appears to be very well made. It is sturdy but not overly heavy. The ridges on the inside are higher than I expected. As a result, this is best for frying bacon, making paninis, etc. with a [[ASIN:B005TGY0ME bacon press]] (not included).

OTHER LIKES
- It comes with a lifetime warranty.
- It oven safe up to 500 degrees Fahrenheit.

I used this to make scrambled eggs and because the ridges are large, the result was uneven and difficult as egg got stuck in the ridges. I own a [[ASIN:B01N5G52NJ Circulon 10868 11" Ultimum Forged Aluminum Nonstick Square Grill Pan, Large, Black]] that has ridges but the ridges are small and it works well with eggs and pancakes. This pan, on the other hand, is not as easy to work with when there are liquid ingredients.

CAVEATES
- It has a PTFE (Polytetrafluoroethylene) coating which is dangerous to birds and perhaps dangerous to food.
- This is NOT dishwasher safe.
- Due to the porcelain enamel exterior, there is the risk of this pan fusing to a ceramic or glass cooktop if overheated.
- The handle can get hot with extended cooking.

In summary, my first impressions of this pan were that this is awesome but once I put it to use and read the cardboard instructions, I am not so impressed. It works but there are better solutions available in my opinion.
